The build log of INIT-MANDATE-001. There is exactly one, pinned, opened and written by `mandate-builder[bot]`. The lead adds one comment for each merge, failure and stop. The rules are in `CLAUDE.md`, "The lead: how a task moves".

Each entry:

```
<date and time, UTC> (wave W<n>)
Started: <task ids and PRs>
Merged: <PRs and merge shas>
Failed: <PRs, rule or command, fix round count>
Waiting on KD: <none, or each item with the exact command or click>
Spend: wave W<n> so far $<y> of $1,000
```

No secrets, no em dashes.
